-- A name is plain when it is one non-empty file name: no path
-- separators, no "..", and not absolute.
is_plain_name(n: str) -> bool =
  post out == False or n.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("a/b.txt") == False
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  n.char_count() > 0 and n != "." and n.split("/").len() == 1 and n.split("\\").len() == 1 and n.split(":").len() == 1 and n.split("..").len() == 1

-- Reads one file from inside notes. Missing or unreadable gives None.
read_note(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  pre is_plain_name(name)
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == None
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return None
    text

-- Returns the text of the first readable name in notes, or "".
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  for name in names
    if is_plain_name(name)
      let text = read_note(name) else continue
      return text
  ""
